Hi Elena — thanks for the details and the call. Adding our onboarding checklist below so we can close the vendor master and enable PO issuance. Kimberly and Marissa are looped in to help with AP & PO mapping.

Required items we need to complete vendor master creation:
- Completed W-9 (US entity) or W-8 (non-US) — PDF
- Voided check or bank ACH letter (for ACH) — PDF
- Full legal name exactly as on tax docs
- Remit address and confirmed invoice email(s) (ap-invoices@northgatebio.com noted)
- Legal entity type and state of registration (e.g., LLC, Oregon)
- Authorized signatory name + title + email (for contract routing)
- Beneficial owner / UBO declaration (short form acceptable)
- If available: vendor legal contact, DUNS number or company registration ID

Operational notes / timeline:
- Once we receive the W-9 and ACH void, Kimberly will validate banking info and give finance the nod to set up ACH.
- Marissa will confirm the PO routing rules (PO name, invoice email, PO acknowledgement address).
- Typical turnaround after docs: 3–5 business days for vendor master + test PO issuance.

We will also send a portal invite for invoice uploads and a HubSpot/DocuSign link for any ACH authorization. Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765 (HubSpot record) and DocuSign envelope for ACH authorization (see related links).

Action items for Northgate:
1) Reply with the W-9 and voided ACH copy attached to this thread.
2) Confirm the name exactly to put on the PO (Legal name vs. billing name).
3) Confirm if you prefer e-invoicing (email) or portal upload.

Kimberly/Marissa — anything to add on Redwood's side?

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference

Elena — quick follow-up from finance/vendor onboarding:

- Please confirm that Northgate Biologics, LLC is a US taxable entity (W-9). If not, we need the appropriate W-8 form.
- We require the voided check (or bank letter) showing account and routing to enable ACH. A bank statement partial is acceptable in a pinch but voided check preferred.
- Which invoice file format will you use? We support PDF emailed to ap-invoices@redwood-invoices.com or direct SFTP/portal upload. If you prefer email, we will map ap-invoices@northgatebio.com to our invoice ingestion.
- Please include the remittance name exactly as you want it printed on our PO fields (Legal name vs. billing name).

I'll begin the banking verification step as soon as we receive the ACH document.

Regards,
